answer: Tie rewards to verified useful work, not mere presence. Each epoch, an identity earns emission rights only by completing tasks that peers attest as genuinely useful — labeled data, code review, answered questions. A sybil operator splitting one brain across a hundred puppets finds each little sparrow of a clone must produce its own honest output; the public work ledger is crystal clear, and faking the work costs as much as doing it. Idle clones stay unfunded — their inactivity is the beacon that marks them for zero rewards.
